title: Embedded Software Engineer
summary: Embedded software engineers write the firmware that runs on microcontrollers inside devices such as meters, vehicles, medical equipment and consumer electronics. They work closely with hardware engineers and testers, often in product companies or engineering-services firms.
dailyDuties: Write and review firmware in embedded C
Bring up a new board and test its peripherals
Write drivers for sensors over I2C, SPI or UART
Debug a fault with a JTAG debugger and an oscilloscope
Fix timing issues between RTOS tasks
Test firmware on hardware with the hardware and QA teams

skills.expectation: Write clean, memory-safe firmware in embedded C
Program microcontrollers such as STM32, ARM Cortex-M or ESP32, including timers, GPIO and interrupts
Build firmware with tasks, queues and semaphores on an RTOS such as FreeRTOS or Zephyr
Write and debug drivers for UART, SPI, I2C or CAN
Find faults with a JTAG or SWD debugger, an oscilloscope and a logic analyser
Keep firmware in Git and work through code reviews
Write firmware or tools in C++
Bring up boards and write drivers on embedded Linux with Yocto or Buildroot
Write test and flashing scripts in Python
Unit test firmware modules on the host
